# CANDIDATE: 1DTE_VWAP_CONT_OVERRIDE_REALFILLS_WF

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** parameter change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Overriding the VWAP_CONT setup to use 1DTE (instead of 0DTE) may improve edge_capture on J anchor days by reducing theta decay and improving fill quality, while maintaining sufficient premium to allow ≥3 contracts at a $2k account. The BS-synthetic Stage-1 showed edge_capture=759.21 (below OP-16 floor of 771), but real-fills may differ due to ITM premium overestimation in BS sim (L23).

## Mechanism

The VWAP_CONT setup triggers on the first morning bar (≤10:30 ET) where the first 3 RTH closes are on the same side of session VWAP and the bar continues in-trend. The override changes `j_vwap_cont_dte_override` from 0 to 1, shifting expiration to next-day. Entry logic (limit at mid), stop (chart-stop primary, 50% premium stop catastrophe cap), and target (TP1 at +100% premium, runner) remain unchanged. Uses 1DTE OPRA chain for fills.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** $2k account (Bold) allows 3 contracts max under 50% risk cap; requires entry premium ≤ $6.67/contract (3 contracts × 100 × 0.5 × premium ≤ $1000 risk). VWAP_CONT typically trades $0.50-$2.00 premium zone, so sizing feasible pending real-fills verification.
2. **Sample bias:** Will use 2025-Q3 through 2026-Q3 (4 quarters) OOS window; selection method is walk-forward with fixed IS/OOS split; overfit risk mitigated by OP-16 anchor gating and concentration disclosure.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (real-fills WF pending)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation pending)
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: large loss on loser day if engine takes adverse 1DTE trade; max drawdown: could exceed 50% if multiple losing days; blow-up scenario: volatility crush on 1DTE options causing rapid premium erosion.
6. **Concentration:** NEEDS-CONCENTRATION (top-5 days % P&L unknown pending real-fills WF)
